title: Web client: attachment upload, display, and download
description:
Add file attachment support to the kith web client (web/app.js + web/index.html + web/style.css).

The kithd backend is fully implemented: blob upload/download endpoints, attachment metadata in SQLite, Message/set create accepts an attachments array, Peer/deliver passes attachment metadata. The only missing piece is the browser UI.

**User-visible outcome when done:**
- User can click a paperclip icon or drag-drop a file into the compose area
- File is uploaded via POST to the session uploadUrl, returning a blobId
- Message/set create includes the attachment in the attachments array
- Received messages (own and peer) display attachment metadata (filename, size) with a download link
- Download link fetches from the blob download endpoint

**Scope boundary:**
- Browser JS/HTML/CSS only; no Rust changes
- No TUI attachment UI (separate epic)
- No peer-blob-fetch (separate epic)
- No multi-file drag-drop (single file per message for MVP)

**Security invariants:**
- Filename displayed via textContent (never innerHTML) to prevent XSS
- Upload size limit enforced by backend; UI handles 413/error gracefully
- Download link is a bare anchor with the blob URL; no eval, no innerHTML
